description: One call for 'I have X calories and Y g protein left today — what can I eat?': looks up each named food in CoFID UK food data (search_foods, best match) and gives the grams that close the protein gap without passing the calories left. Never show the user codes or raw records.

foods.description: Foods they have, e.g. 'chicken breast grilled', 'greek yogurt', 'eggs boiled'.
